name: Umbra Sight's optional draw-into-memory + curse-lineage damage
notes: Umbra Sight is UMBRA (advanced element), so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real UMBRA champion (Tristan, Shadowdancer) to unlock element access, matching the pattern used elsewhere in this file for other UMBRA cards. Its printed reserve cost is a real 0 (not the '-1 = no reserve type' sentinel), so no reserve-payment decision is ever queued. After the unconditional draw and an unrelated optional MZMAYCHOOSE (declined with PASS), the card's own YESNO offers the optional draw-into-memory + curse-lineage effect; choosing YES adds it to the champion's lineage and deals 2 unpreventable damage per curse already in that lineage (2, counting itself).

rulesClauses: You may draw a card into your memory and put Umbra Sight on the bottom of your champion's lineage. When you do, deal 2 unpreventable damage to your champion for each Curse card in your champion's lineage.
